messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Update, Package reorganization & refactoring
parts:
Hi all,
 
I'm planning some package reorganization over the next week or so to address some licensing issues, clarify the structure of the code, and integrate the new interpreter/jitting compiler.
I'm not sure to what extent folks have outstanding commits, or are referencing the API in other projects, so I thought I would give a heads up.

First,
I've acquired the renjin.org domain, so I will be moving all code into the org.renjin package to better conform with java coding conventions.

Here is the basic outline:

module org.renjin:renjin-data 
License: LGPL
Classes:  vectors and other data structures, and data reader/writer 
(mostly former r.lang),  e.g.:

org.renjin.data.SEXP
org.renjin.data.Vector
org.renjin.data.DoubleVector
org.renjin.data.Environment
etc

module org.renjin:renjin-math
License: GPL
Includes any math routines that could be
independently useful to a Java developer
org.renjin.math.xx

module org.renjin:renjin-interpreter
License: GPL
org.renjin.interpreter
org.renjin.interpreter
org.renjin.compiler
org.renjin.primitives
org.renjin.base

The idea being that between the javax.scripting and org.renjin.data classes, java programmers can depend on renjin without directly referencing GPL'd APIs. (I'm still a bit foggy as to the consequences of this-- I would like to license renjin as liberally as possible but renjin is absolutely derivative of the GPL'd R and I want to honor that)

Best,

Alex
